_status: First reading (12 October 2026), CANON session: read from the score (Mutopia engravings, data/sources/bach-canons) with the detector's candidates (docs/canons/CANDIDATES.md) as a guide; every row checked against the title and, where marked 'seen', against the engraving. Voices are the reader's ids in data/canons/corpus.json. Lags in the notated beat of the metre and in bars. Interval: diatonic size between corresponding notes of leader and follower (for contrary motion: between the first two corresponding notes), and the side the follower is on.
